title.narrative: Strengthening the HIV and TB National Response - Egypt (01-Apr-2025-31-Mar-2028)

description.narrative: Egypt, TB/HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Egypt Co)This program has the following goals: Reduce TB incidence by 80% by 2030 compared to 2015 (15 cases / 100 000 population). Reduce the number of TB death by 90% by 2030 compared to 2015. The objectives of this program are: To increase TB treatment coverage from 88% in 2023 to 95% by 2030 and to reach TB treatment success rate to at least 95% by 2030. To detect RR/MDR-TB cases and enroll at least 95% on second line treatment and successfully treat 90% of them by 2030. To increase HIV testing among notified TB Cases from 69% in 2023 to 100% by 2030 and to treat near 100% of identified TB/HIV with ARVs. Increase TPT coverage to more than 90% among all eligible groups as per the national policy by 2030. Increase the percentage of people living with HIV who know their status from 64% in 2023 to 78% by 2027. Raise the percentage of people on antiretroviral therapy (ART) among all PLHIV from 46.15% in 2023 to 53% by 2027. Increase the percentage of MSM reached with HIV prevention programs from 1.9% in 2023 to 50% by 2027, and the percentage of PWID reached from 10.9% to 50% in the same period, with a focus on comprehensive prevention services including condom distribution, PrEP, and harm reduction programs. Increase the percentage of MSM receive an HIV test and know their results to 76% by 2027, while for People who use drugs is 50% through targeted testing campaigns and integration of HIV testing into routine services for these groups
